subject: Post-call: cost model, token bands & startup incentive request — Arcade.ai
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@arcade.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: cost model, token bands & startup incentive request — Arcade.ai

Hi Priya — thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side. I attached an updated cost model (Arcade_cost_model_v2.xlsx).

Key points we captured:
- Current trial: ~10M tokens/month (chat+moderation mix), median prompt+response ~300 tokens.
- Forecast: grow to ~30–50M tokens/month by month 6 if the pilot proves out UX.
- Preferred latency SLO: p95 < 400ms for short-turn responses.
- Your stated target unit economics: $50–$80 per 1M tokens as the budget anchor today; CFO flagged $6k–$8k/mo for next quarter.

Options we discussed (high level):
- Hosted usage (no commit): baseline price today = $120 / 1M tokens (public list for same model).
- Startup program: temporary discount for qualified early-stage customers (can be structured as N months at X% off).
- Committed-use discounts: 6/12/24 month tiers with increasing discounts and reserved slot priority.

Ask from you: confirm the headcount/feature milestone cadence tied to your token ramp (do you expect linear ramp or in-app spikes), and whether the CFO would consider a 12-month committed path if it gets us below ~$45 / 1M tokens at scale.

Proposed next step on our side: Ben and Marissa — can you review the attached model and propose one concrete pricing option we can put on the table (startup + a committed option) to send Priya? Ideally include an illustrative $/1M for 10M, 30M, 50M bands and any founder credit we can extend.

Thanks —
Jordan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0112

[Attachment: Arcade_cost_model_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Priya Shah <priya@arcade.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: cost model, token bands & startup incentive request — Arcade.ai

Thanks Jordan — this looks reasonable and helpful. A couple clarifications from our side before you craft formal options: 

- Our immediate pilot is constrained to $6k–$8k/mo but the product team expects adoption to increase quickly if latency and quality hold — likely to 30–40M/mo in 4–6 months.
- Our CFO asked if we could get to ~$40 / 1M tokens with a 24-month commitment — that would make this viable long-term.
- We’d also ask for a short founder credit (one or two months) on top of an initial discount to help bridge the pilot.

Can you propose a 6mo startup path + a 12mo committed path and an example 24mo structure (even if conditional)? Also confirm if we can reserve capacity slots for Q4 (we need predictable throughput).

— Priya
Head of Platform, Arcade.ai
pri...@arcade.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: cost model, token bands & startup incentive request — Arcade.ai

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Priya. They explicitly asked: can we get to ~$40 / 1M with a 24-month commit and request 1–2 months founder credit. Also they want capacity reservation for Q4.

Priya’s pilot budget is tight ($6–8k/mo) but upside to 30–50M/mo in months. Please propose a clean set of options we can present:
- Option A: Startup program (what % off, duration, any founder credit) with no long-term commitment.
- Option B: 12-mo commit (show effective $/1M at 10/30/50M bands).
- Option C: 24-mo commit (show whether $40 / 1M is achievable, plus reserved capacity terms).

Also flag any legal / SOW steps and whether finance needs a revenue ops review before offering founder credit.

Thanks —
Jordan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: cost model, token bands & startup incentive request — Arcade.ai

Thanks — ran the numbers against our cost tiers and current promotional guardrails. Draft options below (rounded):

Baseline assumptions:
- Runtime & infra savings expected via KV caching and batch strategy at Arcade’s 300-token median: ~18–22% effective token reduction (counts-as tokens billed may vary; model assumes conservative 15% savings).
- List baseline (no discounts): $120 / 1M tokens.

Pricing options to present:
1) Startup path (qualifies under founder program):
   - 6 months at 40% off baseline -> $72 / 1M effective.
   - Founder credit: one-time $6k credit applied to first invoice.
   - No long-term commit, priority onboarding + a single capacity reservation window (Q4 slot, best-effort).

2) 12-month committed-use (monthly consumption commitment tiers):
   - Commitment: 12mo, 30M tokens/mo committed avg -> 20% off baseline -> $96 -> effective $96 less discounts? (need correction). WAIT must be coherent: baseline $120, 20% off -> $96. But target $/1M should decrease further for higher volume. We should present banded effective pricing:
   - 10M band: $100 / 1M
   - 30M band: $68 / 1M
   - 50M band: $56 / 1M
   - (All above include commitment discount + auto-batching reclaim savings; exact tiers in attached pricing sheet.)
   - No founder credit for 12mo standard unless approved by RevOps (recommend $3k one-time).

3) 24-month multi-year (slot reservation + deeper discount):
   - 24mo commitment with reserved capacity: 25% off baseline + volume-linked rebates -> target at scale can reach ~$40–45 / 1M once >40M tokens/mo sustained and after rebates.
   - Propose conditional rebate structure: start at $60 / 1M, with step-down rebates triggered at 30M and 50M sustained months, plus an end-of-year usage true-up.
   - Founder credit: we can offer 2 months free equivalent (~$12k) only with RevOps sign-off and legal SOW acceptance.

Immediate recommendation to Jordan: send Option 1 (startup 6mo @ $72/1M + $6k founder credit) and Option 3 as aspirational (24mo target to hit ~$40/1M with reserved slots + rebates). This gives Arcade runway for pilot and a path to their target economics.

Operational asks:
- Marissa: can you confirm SOW template and whether RevOps will approve a $6k or $12k founder credit for ARR < $200k?
- Jordan: once approved, I’ll draft a short term sheet and pricing sheet (CSV) to attach.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

[Attachment: proposed_pricing_sheet.csv (csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: cost model, token bands & startup incentive request — Arcade.ai

Jordan / Ben — good synthesis. Approvals & next steps from ops/legal: 

1) RevOps check: I spoke with Ops — we can approve a one-time $6k founder credit for qualifying startups (criteria: < $5M ARR, YC/seed investor signal or founder intro). For Arcade — priya indicated early-stage; need one-line investor reference or cap table snippet before credit is applied.
2) SOW / legal: RevOps will need a statement-of-work for any reserved capacity. I’ve attached a draft SOW (Arcade_SOW_v1.pdf) to customize.
3) Quoting: Ben — please prepare two quotes:
   - Quote A: Startup (6mo at $72 / 1M + $6k credit) — no commit, best-effort Q4 slot.
   - Quote B: 24mo reserved (conditional rebates) — show initial price $60 / 1M with step-downs to $45 then $40 once 50M sustained; include reserved slot SLA and a true-up clause.

If Jordan agrees we can send both to Priya and ask the CFO to indicate whether they want to pursue the reserve/24mo path. I’ll loop in RevOps (revops@redwood.ai) and Legal for the SOW once they indicate direction.

Recommend messaging to Priya: concise table + clear ask from them (investor proof + target commit length). Jordan — send when ready.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Programs — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

[Attachment: Arcade_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)]
